blockingFindings.title: Spec-local regression coverage is missing from the implementation diff
blockingFindings.issue: R6 requires regression tests under `specs/307-stop-creating-presets-template/tests/` proving R1 through R5, but the provided touched file set and diff include only `src/lib/preset-deploy.js` and `src/upgrade.js`; no spec-local test file or assertions are included.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add or include `specs/307-stop-creating-presets-template/tests/deploy-preset-copies.test.js` with a `// spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6` header and assertions covering the deploy target set, unchanged existing `creating_presets.md`, base guardrail/rubric copies, non-base rubric exclusion, and rename-migration skip behavior.
blockingFindings.rationale: Without the required spec-local coverage, acceptance requirement R6 is not satisfied, so the implementation cannot proceed under the stated spec even though the production changes address the behavior.
